sources.name: Autodesk 2024 Common Dimension Group Codes
observations: Group 2 names the block containing the dimension picture.
Group 41 is dimension text-line spacing factor; group 42 is actual measurement; group 53 is text rotation; group 51 is horizontal direction.
The listed common DIMENSION grammar does not document anonymous-block XYZ scale or its placement rotation.
sources.limitation: Scoped DXF entity reference evidence; not proof against undocumented legacy extensions or application-private data.

sources.name: Autodesk 2024 INSERT group codes
observations: INSERT uses 41/42/43 for XYZ scale and 50 for rotation.
These are block-reference fields and cannot be assumed to apply to a DIMENSION entity.

sources.name: Autodesk BLOCKS and BLOCK references
observations: BLOCKS contains anonymous blocks used by associative dimensions.
Block contents may contain INSERT, and the BLOCK base point participates in the content coordinate definition.
sources.limitation: Suggests a possible transform-baking route, but does not specify a lossless DWG-DIMENSION-to-DXF transformation.

sources.name: ezdxf dimension documentation/source
observations: AutoCAD requires the anonymous dimension-picture block for visible dimension lines according to the tutorial.
The renderer is approximate and does not implement every DIMSTYLE combination.
The API/source has a separate OCS/elevation transformation route for picture primitives.
sources.limitation: Implementation and parser lead only; no native application result and no mapping of DWG anonymous-block scale/rotation.

sources.name: LibreDWG 0.13.4 generated DIMENSION API documentation
observations: Generated fields label ins_rotation as DXF 54, while Autodesk's common DIMENSION group-code table does not list code 54.
sources.limitation: No pinned LibreDWG build or exact output drawing was run; this is a source-documentation discrepancy, not proof of a valid standard mapping.
